_metadata.description: Test Genie structure-phase provider cutover and the thin, discoverable, human-default CLI surface.

requirements.title: Test Genie structure phase served by structure-health
requirements.description: Test Genie's structure phase delegates to structure-health over scenario-validation/v1; the native Structure runner and scenario-auditor structure/config/ui packs are deleted; the provider-contract scan recognizes the provider with adoption_score=1.

validation.notes: provider-contract scan reports structure-health as a recognized provider (adoption_score=1, 0 offenders); test-genie/scenario-auditor baseline diffs exit 0 (phase-relocation triaged).

requirements.title: Thin Connect-client CLI with stable command surface
requirements.description: The CLI exposes validate/fix-config/fleet as thin manifest-bound Connect-client wrappers with no business logic; the app constructs, reports version/metadata, and renders help listing the command groups.

validation.notes: cli/app_test.go covers construction, version, metadata, and help rendering of the registered command groups.

requirements.title: Human output by default, JSON opt-in
requirements.description: Every command renders a useful human report by default via the shared maturity/proto renderers; --json emits the structurally equivalent payload for programmatic consumers and is never required for the command to be useful.

validation.notes: Live `structure-health validate scenario <id>` and `... --json` produce a useful human report and structurally equivalent JSON respectively.
